categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai CEO Environmental Protection Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the environmental protection equipment manufacturing sector, focusing on sludge dewatering and drying integrated technology equipment, exhaust gas purification technology equipment, energy-saving and carbon reduction technology equipment, and related operation and maintenance services. The company also extends its business into industrial solid waste and special material solid-liquid separation, energy-saving carbon reduction, and clean energy fields, providing comprehensive environmental solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technologies include low-temperature vacuum dewatering and drying integrated technology, advanced exhaust gas purification technologies (such as active oxygen ion purification, composite physical-chemical purification, biofilter purification, and molecular capture catalytic oxidation), and high-temperature water source heat pump technology. It has developed proprietary high-temperature drying filter plates, replacing imported products, and integrates mechanical pressing with vacuum drying to efficiently reduce sludge moisture content while lowering energy consumption and emissions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are large state-owned enterprises, listed companies, and leading private enterprises in municipal and industrial wastewater treatment sectors. The company serves municipal and industrial wastewater treatment plants, industrial parks, and sectors such as petrochemical, coal, food, pharmaceuticals, non-ferrous metals, and light industry. It also targets emerging markets in green fuels and carbon asset management services.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s main operations are concentrated in China, especially in the Yangtze River Delta, Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, and other key domestic regions. It has begun expanding internationally, showcasing products at major exhibitions in Germany and exploring markets in Hong Kong and Macau. It also has subsidiaries and investments in provinces such as Zhejiang, Jiangsu, Henan, Hubei, and an overseas subsidiary in Singapore.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai CEO Environmental Protection Technology Co., Ltd. operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the environmental protection supply chain. It manufactures core equipment and provides integrated solutions and services for sludge treatment and exhaust gas purification, as well as energy-saving and carbon reduction technologies, serving wastewater treatment plants and industrial customers directly.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation-driven development, focusing on green, low-carbon, and circular economy technologies. It invests heavily in R&D for sludge dewatering and drying, exhaust gas purification, advanced heat pump technologies, hydrogen production and storage, and green fuel development such as green methanol. It collaborates with universities and research institutes to advance technology platforms and accelerate commercialization, aiming to become a global leader in energy-saving and low-carbon high-end equipment.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through sales of high-end solid-liquid separation equipment, exhaust gas purification equipment, energy-saving heat pump equipment, and related spare parts. The company also earns income from long-term operation and maintenance services, contract energy management, BOT projects, and customized technical solutions. Revenue recognition is based on contract progress for large projects and upon delivery or service completion for others.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in China’s advanced environmental protection equipment sector, particularly in sludge dewatering and drying integrated technology, where it has proprietary technology with no direct domestic or international equivalents. It competes in a fragmented market with many small players but distinguishes itself through technological innovation, comprehensive solutions, and strong regional market presence, especially in Shanghai and Guangzhou.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 186.9 million, a 67.56% decrease from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 50.38 million. The decline was mainly due to macroeconomic challenges and delayed project progress. Despite this, the company maintains total assets of about RMB 1.37 billion and net assets of RMB 1.17 billion, with a strong R&D investment ratio of 18.14%. It has a workforce of 233 employees, including 98 R&D personnel.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company’s unique value proposition lies in its proprietary low-temperature vacuum dewatering and drying integrated technology that significantly reduces sludge moisture content in one step with lower energy consumption and carbon emissions compared to traditional two-stage processes. Its self-developed high-temperature drying filter plates outperform imported alternatives in performance and cost. The company offers comprehensive, green, low-carbon, and circular economy solutions, integrating sludge treatment, exhaust gas purification, energy-saving technologies, and carbon management services, positioning itself as a leader in sustainable environmental protection equipment.
